title: Better to Ask in English: Evaluation of Large Language Models on English, Low-resource and Cross-Lingual Settings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing zero-shot prompting performance (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1 scores) of Large Language Models on Natural Language Inference (XNLI) and topic classification (SIB-200) tasks across English and low-resource South Asian languages (Bangla, Hindi, and Urdu) using original and cross-lingual translated prompts.
